rationale.tooling-supply-chain: Characterizes and detects vulnerabilities in third-party agent skill packages.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Static regex and code analysis deterministically detect dangerous skill patterns.
rationale.ai-review: LLM-based semantic classifiers independently judge skills for security vulnerabilities.
rationale.risk-routing: Confidence and severity thresholds select uncertain or risky skills for human review.
rationale.framework: SkillScan is a reusable multi-stage security-vetting pipeline.
rationale.built-system: Authors implemented and evaluated SkillScan on 31,132 marketplace skills.
rationale.risk-security: Reports empirical security vulnerabilities and evaluates a mitigation detector.
rationale.method-mining: Mines marketplace skills, repositories, metadata, and vulnerability patterns.
rationale.method-experiment: Executes 25 third-party skills under controlled container monitoring.
